brief:
Al-Quds Open University and Ma'an Media Network discussed expanding their partnership and launching community initiatives, the Ma'an news agency reported. The two organizations explored collaborative opportunities to strengthen their work in Palestinian communities.

Details of the proposed initiatives and timeline for implementation were not disclosed. The discussions reflect ongoing efforts by both institutions to deepen cooperation on educational and media projects.
title: Al-Quds Open University, Ma'an Media Network expand partnership plans
